drills.title: Cone Weave
drills.cue: Head over foot. Outside peg. Steady RPM.
instructions: Weave through the cones, combining head-over-foot alignment, outside-peg weighting, and clutch control at steady RPM.
Adjust spacing as you practice.
setupDetails: Start with 9–10 cones in a line. Count and spacing are flexible.
Begin with wide gaps and progressively bring the cones closer together.

drills.title: Moving Outside-Peg Weight
drills.cue: Head over foot. Weight the outside peg.
instructions: While moving, align your head over the outside foot and weight that peg.
Progress toward full steering lock while maintaining the alignment.
Practice turns in both directions.

drills.title: On / Off / Out / In Drill
drills.cue: Throttle on, throttle off, clutch out, clutch in. Keep throttle input separate from clutch release.
instructions: Start with the clutch fully pulled in.
Apply throttle, then close it.
Only after the throttle is closed, release the clutch, then pull it fully back in.
Repeat, preserving the separation between throttle input and clutch release.
Practice in motion and stationary with feet on the ground where possible.
setupDetails: Use flat ground. An incline is optional.

drills.title: Static Balance
drills.cue: Head over foot. Steer toward the fall.
instructions: Work on balance in both steering directions.
Weight the outside peg and align your head over that foot.
Steer toward the direction of the fall to correct your balance.
Focus on front-brake control.

drills.title: Incline Clutch Control
drills.cue: Steady RPM. Control movement with the friction zone.
instructions: Use the clutch friction zone to control rolling up and down the incline.
Keep the RPM steady as you adjust clutch engagement.

drills.title: Rear Brake–Clutch Handoff
drills.cue: Transfer the hold without moving.
instructions: At low RPM, practice transferring between holding the bike with the rear brake and holding it through the clutch friction zone.
Keep the bike stationary during each handoff.

drills.title: Front Stuff Balance
drills.cue: Front tire against the obstacle. Maintain steady RPM.
instructions: Position the front tire against the obstacle.
Combine balance and clutch control while maintaining steady RPM.
Slip the clutch slightly to help press the front tire into the obstacle.
Practice seated, then standing, then progress to rolling in.
setupDetails: Sizable obstacle such as a rock or log, roughly over 1 ft tall.

drills.title: Outside-Peg Mount and Dismount
drills.cue: Find balance before swinging your leg.
instructions: Find balance on the outside peg before swinging a leg over the bike.
Practice mounting and dismounting with attention to front-brake control and full steering lock.
setupDetails: Space beside the bike. Uphill variant optional.

drills.title: On-Command Balance
drills.cue: Carry moving balance into a complete stop.
instructions: Begin with moving outside-peg balance.
Come to a complete stop while preserving head-over-foot alignment and outside-peg weighting.

drills.title: Full-Lock Rectangle
drills.cue: Outside peg and steady clutch control at full lock.
instructions: Alternate full-lock turns within the rectangle.
Coordinate outside-peg weight, body position, and steady clutch control.
Aim to fit in as many turns as you can.
setupDetails: Cone rectangle with adjustable dimensions and spacing.

drills.title: Ready, Acceleration, and Deceleration Positions
drills.cue: Move between the three positions.
instructions: Rehearse the ready, acceleration, and deceleration positions and the transitions between them.

drills.title: Loading the Flywheel
drills.cue: Close the throttle before the incline transition.
instructions: Practice timing the falling engine RPM as you approach the incline transition.
Close the throttle before the transition.

drills.title: Engine-Off Clutch-Up Rehearsal
drills.cue: Rehearse the coordination with the engine off.
instructions: Rehearse coordinating hip movement, suspension rebound, throttle, front brake, and clutch.

drills.title: Engine-Running Clutch-Up Rehearsal
drills.cue: Coordinate the movement with falling RPM.
instructions: Use the one-foot-down progression to rehearse clutch-up coordination, paying attention to falling RPM.

drills.title: Rolling Suspension Compression and Rebound
drills.cue: Coordinate with the rebound. Avoid pulling on the bars.
instructions: While rolling, practice suspension compression and the body-position transition as the suspension rebounds.

drills.title: Rolling Clutch-Only Lift
drills.cue: Steady throttle. Coordinate suspension and clutch.
instructions: While rolling, maintain steady throttle and coordinate suspension movement with clutch timing to practice lifting the front wheel.
setupDetails: Open riding area. Builds on Incline Clutch-Up.

drills.title: Obstacle Approach Body Position
drills.cue: Coordinate your position with front-tire contact.
instructions: Practice the body-position change as the front tire transitions onto the obstacle.

drills.title: Incline Clutch-Up
drills.cue: Weight shift, rebound, clutch timing, controlled return.
instructions: Coordinate weight shift, suspension rebound, and clutch timing to practice lifting the front wheel.
Include control of the front wheel's return.

drills.title: Trials Lines and Gates
drills.cue: Connect balance and control along a marked line.
instructions: Follow the marked line, combining balance, body position, and clutch/throttle control through the gates.

drills.title: Full Clutch-Up
drills.cue: Move your body forward before delivering power.
instructions: Combine the clutch-up rehearsals into the complete movement.
Move your body forward before delivering power.
When practicing over an obstacle, pull the clutch in as soon as the rear tire contacts it.

drills.title: Front-Tire Placement
drills.cue: Place the front tire on the obstacle.
instructions: Use the one-foot-down progression to practice placing the front tire on the obstacle.

drills.title: Unstuck Technique
drills.cue: Body forward before power. Clutch in at rear-tire contact.
instructions: Start with the front tire on the obstacle.
Move your body forward before delivering power.
Pull the clutch in as soon as the rear tire contacts the obstacle.
setupDetails: Start with the front tire on an obstacle.

drills.title: Rut Control
drills.cue: Weight the peg that presses the tire into the rut.
instructions: Weight the peg that presses the tire into the rut.
Maintain rear-wheel traction through throttle and clutch control.

drills.title: Sidehill Control
drills.cue: Downhill peg weight and rear-wheel traction.
instructions: Apply the balance and traction control practiced in Rut Control to a sidehill.
Focus on downhill peg weighting and throttle and clutch control.
